recommendation_summary: Point the 03:00 cron line at a short wrapper script that runs nightly-sync and, on any non-zero exit, sends the summary email with the error text through a mail path that doesn't depend on the sync token.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to know when nightly-sync is dead without reading logs. You proposed a central log on the Synology, maybe in Docker. The failure was an expired token that crashed startup on edna four nights running, before the summary email.
labels.Deleted: A Synology central log and a Docker logging stack. Unread logs with no page would have stayed silent for the same four nights.
labels.Bottleneck: The finish email is the only signal, so a crash before it leaves nothing to notice.
labels.Checked myself: Only your account: nightly-sync is the sole cron job, 03:00 on Mac mini edna, email only after a finished run, no other alert, Synology can run Docker. I have not seen the script or the crontab.

note: The reply recommends one failure-email alert through a wrapper and admits it misses the case where edna is off or cron never runs, but it doesn't recommend fixing that, so the class is still SMALL.
